race.comment: TALK TOO MUCH (2) chased soundly for second as favourite on debut at Bunbury before a break. He's coming into this with a comfortable Belmont trial win and the rating he produced on debut is very strong for a race like this. MR KAPLAN (10) has been close enough at her past two, beaten just over two lengths at Ascot and Northam, and the visors going on give her a clear chance to sharpen fourth-up. CAPALL GASTA (6) drops out of the Listed Belgravia Stakes after finishing fifth, beaten three lengths, and that form has to be respected in a Mdn despite a long-standing maiden record. INVESTING IN ROSIE (13) was slow away and closed off from well back on debut at Northam. Should be better for that run and she did close in good splits. Worth keeping on side. GINGER MACHINO (14) has shown ability at the trials and is not to be discounted on debut.
